name: Sudden Spoiling — the keyword line above is not part of the subject
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. The lose-all-abilities subject could run across a newline, so it was 'Split second / Until end of turn, creatures target player controls' and the whole spell produced nothing. The subject now stops at a line break. The targeted opponent's Wind Drake is 0/2 without flying; your own Drake is untouched. The same change removes inert static effects that leaked out of triggers on the line below a keyword line (Abigale, Warkite Marauder).
